name: create_collection
description: Create one matching zone + group for a user-described place or plant set, atomically. Keep unknown physical location explicit. Reuse existing IDs; never substitute a shelf with only a group. Assign individual cards to returned zone. Existing structure repair uses gardening_structure.
title: create collection

name: gardening_card
description: Inspect, prepare and apply a compact sourced memory for one card without rewriting history. Check names of card, shelf/zone and group; propose missing names and get approval. Read relevant paginated history; distinguish facts, hypotheses, plans and performed actions. Apply only exact approved plan; concurrent changes reject it. Restore creates a new version, not deletion.
title: gardening card

name: gardening_structure
description: Inspect structure; if inconsistent offer optimization. After consent ask 1–2 main questions, confirm assumptions and missing names, then prepare a proposal. Apply only the exact user-approved stored plan. Pairs and assignments preserve IDs/history; no deletes, nesting or cross-zone groups.
title: gardening structure

name: get_feedback_status
description: Check whether developer feedback delivery is configured; returns Telegram contact. Read-only.
title: get feedback status

name: send_feedback
description: Send a user-approved short review, wish, suggestion or bug report to developer @dyingseed via Telegram. First show the summary and ask consent. No full conversation, photos, credentials or unrelated private details. Reuse id on retry; uncertain/pending outcomes must not be resent under a new ID.
title: send feedback

name: get_feedback_report
description: Read status of own feedback report, never resends it. sent means Telegram accepted, not that a human read it.
title: get feedback report

name: get_capabilities
description: Authoritative current GrowKeeper capabilities, limitations, release version and runtime readiness. Use whenever explaining features, checking support for a requested action, deciding how to perform it, or uncertain about plugin abilities. Read-only; not a list of all ChatGPT capabilities.
title: get capabilities

name: new_ids
description: Generate UUIDs for new entities. Reuse an ID when retrying the same create, not a different create.
title: new ids

name: get_plants
description: List plants and trusted reference photo IDs. A single existing plant is NOT proof that an incoming image is that plant.
title: get plants

name: get_settings
description: Read recognition threshold and timezone.
title: get settings

name: get_monitoring_status
description: Read actual subscription readiness, expiry and whether a useful opt-in offer is appropriate. Never reveals callback or signing secrets.
title: get monitoring status

name: record_monitoring_choice
description: Record offered only when actually offering monitoring; declined only after user refusal; reset only on user request to reconsider. Record shortcut_offered only after showing the Android home-screen suggestion; it does not mean installation. This does NOT subscribe, unsubscribe or grant consent.
title: record monitoring choice

name: set_settings
description: Change settings only at the user’s request. Recognition score is heuristic, not a calibrated probability.
title: set settings

name: create_zone
description: Create a user-described physical area, e.g. balcony or upper shelf. Flat zones, no invented hierarchy.
title: create zone

name: update_zone
description: Rename or describe a known zone; preserve its identity.
title: update zone

name: assign_plant_zone
description: Assign an existing plant, bed or group to a user-described zone. clear=true removes only the location link.
title: assign plant zone

name: name_plant
description: Name or rename a plant/bed/group without changing its profile or identity. On first photos use one wholesome funny generated name if none chosen by user. Generated names are usable immediately, never proof of visual identity.
title: name plant

name: record_collection_progress
description: Record real user activity and onboarding progress. Answer urgent question first; asked only after asking; answered after saving described collection; declined only after refusal. Activity cancels only the pending silence check. user_message_at is the actual user message timestamp, never a background wake.
title: record collection progress

name: schedule_collection_checkin
description: Schedule ONE gentle check-in after 24h silence, 08:00-22:00 user timezone, only after answering immediate question and explicit proactive-care consent plus active subscription. Link the existing plant needing care. Never invent a plant or schedule repeated onboarding nudges.
title: schedule collection checkin

name: create_plant
description: Create a plant/bed/group. Offer one funny name; mark name_confirmed only when accepted. Reuse id on retry.
title: create plant

name: update_plant
description: Rename a plant or edit its profile after user direction. Supply the version from the current entity.
title: update plant

name: record_input
description: Persist unassigned text before resolving its plant. One logical subject per input; split a message about different plants.
title: record input

name: get_pending_inputs
description: Read unresolved text/photo inputs; never ask the user to re-upload a stored image.
title: get pending inputs

name: resolve_input
description: Bind input to plant. For visual matching first view current and trusted reference pixels. Pass heuristic score and conflicts. Below threshold stays pending. Always repeat the returned plant announcement. Do not fake user confirmation.
title: resolve input

name: correct_input
description: Correct mistaken plant assignment after user confirmation, before observations depend on it. Processed history cannot be silently moved.
title: correct input

name: ingest_photo
description: Import the actual ChatGPT file into private R2. Each photo has a separate pending input. Never invent a download_url. JPEG/PNG/WebP, maximum 10 MiB. captured_at only if known; otherwise omit.
title: ingest photo

name: label_photo
description: Store observable view/area and description. A diagnosis is not a photo fact. Only user-confirmed identity may become a trusted reference.
title: label photo

name: get_photo_images
description: Return actual image pixels as MCP image content, up to 4 images / 16 MiB total. MUST use before visual identity or historical comparison; URLs/descriptions alone are not vision.
title: get photo images

name: get_photo_urls
description: Short-lived private photo URLs for the UI. These are not a substitute for get_photo_images when comparing in the model.
title: get photo urls

name: get_comparison_set
description: Select at most 3 older comparable photos for this plant: latest, before experiment, near issue opening/baseline. Then get_photo_images with selected IDs plus current. Do not infer recovery from different framing/light.
title: get comparison set

name: add_observation
description: Record a dated fact, user statement or visual comparison with photo IDs and caveats. No diagnoses as facts. Input must already belong to this plant; comparisons need >=2 distinct photo IDs.
title: add observation

name: create_issue
description: Create a new problem only after checking the existing case file and journal for the same issue. opened_at is first observed detection, not necessarily today.
title: create issue

name: save_hypothesis
description: Create/update a tentative explanation. Facts stay in observations. Non-ACTIVE states require a conclusion; evidence must reference observations of this plant. Update requires expected_version.
title: save hypothesis

name: create_experiment
description: Create a PLANNED experiment, not an action already performed. Define one change, success criteria and evaluation time. Start separately after user reports making the change.
title: create experiment

name: update_experiment
description: Start with user confirmation and actual started_at, or complete/cancel with result. Only one active experiment per plant. Completion is not proof of a causal hypothesis.
title: update experiment

name: create_followup
description: Schedule one future question/photo/check. Does not enable ChatGPT notifications by itself. One followup per useful check, not every hypothesis. Inspect returned monitoring.should_offer; if true, offer one consent-based GrowKeeper event subscription.
title: create followup

name: update_followup
description: After the requested observation is actually processed mark DONE; CANCELLED stops it. PENDING + due_at reschedules. Sending a request is not completion.
title: update followup

name: get_due_followups
description: Read due work. No due work means no proactive message. Reading does not acknowledge delivery. Use one opted-in host monitor or events, not both.
title: get due followups

name: claim_followup
description: For an enabled scheduled host, claim a due followup before sending. Lease prevents simultaneous cron/host delivery. Never claim merely for browsing.
title: claim followup

name: ack_followup
description: After delivering the request, acknowledge its claim. Marks NOTIFIED, never DONE. Retry after expired lease can duplicate a notification; never promise exactly-once delivery.
title: ack followup

name: add_journal_note
description: Add a durable NOTE or MILESTONE. ISSUE_OUTCOME is generated transactionally by close_issue, not manually.
title: add journal note

name: close_issue
description: Close with user agreement after reloading current issue version. UNKNOWN for insufficient evidence; NO_IMPROVEMENT requires actual observations; RESOLVED requires evidence + result_observed_at. This atomically writes the journal and stops related followups. Do not claim failed treatment merely because data is missing.
title: close issue

name: get_case_file
description: Read compact working state, recent photos and long-term journal for one plant. Truncation is explicit; use list_records for older history. Continue existing hypotheses, do not restart every day.
title: get case file

name: list_records
description: Read paginated plant history. Journal search is a simple substring, not semantic/vector search. Follow next_offset; do not mistake one page for the whole history.
title: list records

name: get_entity
description: Read a specific entity including its stable authenticated HTTPS link and version.
title: get entity

name: delete_plant
description: Permanently delete a plant and its photos/history. Destructive: require explicit request and exact plant name. Retry resumes incomplete object deletion.
title: delete plant

name: open_growkeeper
description: Open the interactive GrowKeeper journal/settings UI. Optionally focus an existing entity. Other data tools do not render widgets.
title: open growkeeper
